question: Can the existing runtime-owned lease interruption.intent_token serve as authority_end_id across truthful two-capture authority-ended evidence without minting a new identity?
hypothesis: Bind authority_end_id exactly to terminal.interruption.intent_token only for a verified scheduled authority-ended terminal. Reject missing/empty/mismatched identity and all non-authority-ended or unverified/non-expiry paths. With bridge-v2 validation, the durable token ledger should then issue once, reject same-epoch duplicates, and recover pending across restart.
cases: valid two-capture authority-ended terminal binds existing intent token
durable token issue preserves exact bound ID
same ID with altered post sequence rejects
distinct new intent token with later sequence issues separately
hard_gate: PASS only if all valid cases retain the exact pre-existing runtime token and all forged/non-authority-ending cases reject before token issuance; no case may generate a fresh authority_end_id.
scope: offline interface semantics; retained terminal data and exact current Git source bytes; no GUI/model/network/durable-submit transport; does not certify PR #168 formal source provenance
